title.narrative: Supporting the CENCO Boshop's plennary meeting in preparation to the forth-coming political process

description.narrative: The non-holding of the elections according to the constitutional deadline of December 2016 had given rise to two political negotiations, including those started on December 8, 2016, at the Inter-diocesan Center under the lead of the Bishops of CENCO. This resulted in the signing of the December 31, 2016 of the "Global and inclusive political agreement " between different stakeholders. Since then this agreement has suffered in its actual implementation because of a selective and biased application by the power in place. The failure in the implementation of this agreement left the place for two years to a transition that is significantly dominated by the presidential majority that has tailored the political area to suits their need and interest. The Bishops plenary meeting will aim to design and populate boldly the CENCO's position on the next six months, a period that is crucial in preparation of the forthcoming election. This will guide the message of the church in the 47 dioceses to meaningfully play its role and influence the citizen participation before, during and after the long awaited election.
